_comment: AgentHydra's tray-host config, read by misc/lunarwerx-tray.exe (kit source:
lunarwerx-ui/src/tray-host-native). This file is the whole per-app surface; the host binary is
generic and shared, exactly as AgentHydra-Tray.ps1's $TrayConfig hashtable was.
Paths are relative to THIS file unless absolute. %VAR% expands an environment variable,
%VAR|fallback% supplies a default, and a leading ~ is the user profile. That is what lets one
committed config serve both a source checkout and an extracted release zip with no setup step.
Open shows Hydra Desk 2, AgentHydra's window from 2026-10-06 (owner): openCommand runs its
launcher, which starts Desk 2's server when it is down and opens or focuses its window. The
launcher in turn starts this tray (--background), so either one brings up the other. Where
desk2/ is not beside misc/ (a release zip until it ships Desk 2), `requires` keeps Open on the
daemon's URL, the old window, instead of a script that is not there.
